candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated checkout 502s driven by order ReadTimeout; save_order spans report pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable on postgres. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
